meanings.en: to have to, be forced to
meanings.note: Prefix 'при-' indicates approaching, attachment, or slight degree of action (stem 'ходиться'). Used in Russian as an imperfective verb expressing ongoing, habitual, or repeated action meaning 'to have to', forming an aspectual pair with 'прийтись'. The reflexive suffix '-ся'/'-сь' makes the action intransitive, reciprocal, or directed at the subject.

examples.trans: One has to do everything oneself.
She has to work a lot.

examples.text: Всё приходится делать самой на этой кухне.
examples.trans: One has to do everything herself in this kitchen.

meanings.note: = Enjoy your meal!. Prefix 'при-' indicates approaching, attachment, or slight degree of action (stem 'ятный'). Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('pleasant, nice').

meanings.en: to make up, to make peace
meanings.note: Помириться с кем + instrumental. Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'мириться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to make up, to reconcile', paired with 'мириться'.

examples.trans: Good, I agree to make peace with you.

meanings.note: + infinitive; agrees with the subject: должна (f)
Prefix 'до-' marks reaching a boundary or finishing the remainder of an action (stem 'лжен'). Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('must, should; owe').

examples.text: Жадность, Паша, должна быть умеренная. Комнатной температуры.
